units.source_text: 大公主来到母后那里，

en.t: The Elder Princess came to her mother, the Empress,

units.source_text: 母后问道：“薰大将到你那里去过了么？”

en.t: and her mother asked, "Has General Kaoru been to see you?"

units.source_text: 跟从大公主来的侍女大纳言君答道：“薰大将是来找小宰相君谈话的。”

en.t: Lady Dainagon, an attendant who had accompanied the Elder Princess, replied, "General Kaoru came to talk with Lady Kozaisho."

units.source_text: 母后说：“这个严肃的人也会关心女子而找她谈话？

en.t: The Empress said, "Even that solemn man takes an interest in women and seeks them out for conversation?

units.source_text: 倘是个不大伶俐的女子，应付困难，心底里也将被看透了。

en.t: If the woman were not very clever, she would find him hard to deal with, and he would see right through her heart.

units.source_text: 但小宰相君是很可放心的。”

en.t: But with Lady Kozaisho there is no need to worry."

units.source_text: 她和薰大将虽然是姐弟，但向来对他很客气，故希望侍女们也小心应付他。

en.t: Although General Kaoru was her brother, she had always treated him very courteously, and so she wanted the gentlewomen to be careful in dealing with him too.

units.source_text: 大纳言君又说：“薰大将特别喜欢小宰相君，

en.t: Lady Dainagon went on, "General Kaoru is especially fond of Lady Kozaisho,

units.source_text: 常常到她房中去，长谈细说，直到夜深才出来。

en.t: and he often goes to her room, talks with her at length and in detail, and does not come out until late at night.

units.source_text: 然而恐怕不是普通一般的恋爱吧？

en.t: But perhaps it is not an ordinary love affair, is it?

units.source_text: 小宰相君说匂亲王是个非常薄情的人，所以连回信也不写给他，真屈辱了他！”

en.t: Lady Kozaisho says Prince Niou is terribly heartless, so she will not even write him a reply, which is a real humiliation for him!"

units.source_text: 说罢笑起来。

en.t: After saying this, she began to laugh.

units.source_text: 明石皇后也笑了，说道：“匂亲王那种讨厌的浮薄性情，小宰相君能够看出，却也可喜。

en.t: The Akashi Empress also laughed and said, "It is pleasing that Lady Kozaisho can see Prince Niou's unpleasant frivolous nature.

units.source_text: 我真想设法使他改掉这种恶癖才好。

en.t: I truly wish I could find some way to make him give up that bad habit.

units.source_text: 这实在是可耻的。

en.t: It is truly shameful.

units.source_text: 这里的侍女们也都在讥笑呢。”

en.t: Even the gentlewomen here are laughing at him."

units.source_text: 大纳言君又说：“我还听到很奇怪的事情呢：

en.t: Lady Dainagon continued, "I have also heard something very strange:

units.source_text: 薰大将那个最近死了的女子，是匂亲王夫人的妹妹。

en.t: the woman of General Kaoru's who recently died was the younger sister of Prince Niou's wife.

units.source_text: 大概不是同一母亲所生的吧。

en.t: They were probably not born of the same mother.

units.source_text: 还有一个前常陆守某某之妻，据说是这女子的叔母或母亲，不知究竟是怎么一回事。

en.t: There is also the wife of some former governor of Hitachi, who is said to be either this woman's aunt or her mother; I do not know what the truth is.

units.source_text: 这女子住在宇治，匂亲王和她私通了。

en.t: This woman lived at Uji, and Prince Niou had a secret affair with her.

units.source_text: 薰大将闻讯，立刻准备迎接她进京，添派了许多守夜人去，警备非常森严。

en.t: When General Kaoru heard the news, he immediately prepared to bring her to the capital, sent many more night guards, and made the security extremely strict.

units.source_text: 匂亲王又悄悄地去访，竟不能进门，在马上和一侍女立谈了一会就返京。

en.t: Prince Niou secretly went to visit her again, but in the end he could not get inside; he spoke briefly from horseback with one attendant and then returned to the capital.

units.source_text: 这女子也恋慕匂亲王，有一天忽然失踪了。

en.t: The woman also longed for Prince Niou, and one day she suddenly disappeared.

units.source_text: 乳母等都说她已投水而死，哭得很悲伤呢。”

en.t: Her nurses and the others all said she had thrown herself into the water and died, and they wept most sorrowfully."

units.source_text: 明石皇后听了也很吃惊，说道：“这种话是谁说的？

en.t: The Akashi Empress was also greatly shocked when she heard this, and said, "Who said such a thing?

units.source_text: 真是荒唐可耻的事啊！

en.t: How absurd and shameful!

units.source_text: 不过这样的奇闻，世间自会纷纷传说，何以薰大将不曾说起？

en.t: But with such a strange rumor, people would naturally spread it everywhere; why has General Kaoru never mentioned it?

units.source_text: 他说的只是人世无常之事，以及宇治八亲王一族大都命短之事，深为悲叹而已。”

en.t: He spoke only of the impermanence of human life and of how most of the Eighth Prince of Uji's family died young, and he merely lamented it deeply."

units.source_text: 大纳言君说：“娘娘请听我说：下等仆役说的话靠不住，我也知道。

en.t: Lady Dainagon said, "Your Majesty, please listen to me: I know that the words of lowly servants cannot be trusted.

units.source_text: 但这是在里面当差的一个女童说的。

en.t: But this was said by a young maid who served inside.

units.source_text: 这女童有一天来到小宰相君的娘家，确确实实地说出这件事来。

en.t: One day that young maid came to Lady Kozaisho's family home and told the story quite plainly.

units.source_text: 她还说：‘不要把小姐横死之事告诉别人吧。

en.t: She also said, 'Please do not tell anyone about the young lady's unnatural death.

units.source_text: 情节实在奇离可怕，所以大家尽力隐讳。’

en.t: The circumstances are truly strange and frightening, so everyone is doing their utmost to conceal them.'

units.source_text: 大概宇治那边的人没有详细告诉薰大将吧？”

en.t: Perhaps the people at Uji did not tell General Kaoru the details?"

units.source_text: 明石皇后说：“你叮嘱那个女童：切不可再把这件事说与别人听！

en.t: The Akashi Empress said, "Warn that young maid: she must never tell this matter to anyone again!

units.source_text: 匂亲王如此放荡，深恐将来身败名裂，如之奈何！”

en.t: Prince Niou is so dissolute that I deeply fear he will ruin himself and his reputation in the future; what can be done!"

units.source_text: 她非常担心。

en.t: She was deeply worried.
